                    const roomId = ;
                    
                    // Clock logic
                    function updateClock() {
                        const now = new Date();
                        const timeStr = now.toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit', second: '2-digit', hour12: true });
                        const dateStr = now.toLocaleDateString([], { weekday: 'long', year: 'numeric', month: 'long', day: 'numeric' });
                        document.getElementById('clock-time').textContent = timeStr;
                        document.getElementById('clock-date').textContent = dateStr;
                    }
                    setInterval(updateClock, 1000);
                    updateClock();

                    // Live Data Fetch logic
                    async function fetchKioskData() {
                        try {
                            const response = await fetch('/meeting_room_booking/kiosk/data', {
                                method: 'POST',
                                headers: {
                                    'Content-Type': 'application/json',
                                },
                                body: JSON.stringify({
                                    jsonrpc: '2.0',
                                    method: 'call',
                                    params: { room_id: roomId }
                                }),
                            });
                            const resJson = await response.json();
                            const data = resJson.result;
                            if (data && !data.error) {
                                renderKiosk(data);
                            }
                        } catch (err) {
                            console.error("Failed to load room kiosk data:", err);
                        }
                    }

                    function renderKiosk(data) {
                        // 1. Render Location Information
                        const locBox = document.getElementById('room-location-box');
                        locBox.innerHTML = '';
                        if (data.building || data.floor) {
                            const buildingStr = data.building ? data.building : '';
                            const floorStr = data.floor ? 'Floor ' + data.floor : '';
                            const separator = (data.building && data.floor) ? ', ' : '';
                            locBox.innerHTML = ` ${buildingStr}${separator}${floorStr}`;
                        }

                        // 2. Render Amenities
                        const amenitiesBox = document.getElementById('amenities-box');
                        amenitiesBox.innerHTML = '';
                        data.amenities.forEach(a => {
                            const badge = document.createElement('span');
                            badge.className = 'amenity-badge';
                            // Dynamic icon selection based on name
                            let icon = 'fa-check';
                            const lower = a.toLowerCase();
                            if (lower.includes('projector')) icon = 'fa-video';
                            else if (lower.includes('tv') || lower.includes('display') || lower.includes('screen')) icon = 'fa-tv';
                            else if (lower.includes('board') || lower.includes('marker')) icon = 'fa-chalkboard';
                            else if (lower.includes('phone') || lower.includes('call')) icon = 'fa-phone';
                            else if (lower.includes('wifi') || lower.includes('internet')) icon = 'fa-wifi';
                            
                            badge.innerHTML = ` ${a}`;
                            amenitiesBox.appendChild(badge);
                        });

                        // 3. Render QR Code for scanning
                        const qrImg = document.getElementById('kiosk-qr-code');
                        // Call dynamic Google Chart API QR Generator encoding the booking link
                        qrImg.src = `https://api.qrserver.com/v1/create-qr-code/?size=150x150&data=${encodeURIComponent(data.booking_link)}`;

                        // 4. Render Current Active Card
                        const currentCard = document.getElementById('current-card');
                        const currentTitle = document.getElementById('current-title');
                        const statusLabel = document.getElementById('status-label');
                        const currentMeta = document.getElementById('current-meta');
                        const actionBtn = document.getElementById('action-button');
                        const actionBtnText = document.getElementById('action-btn-text');

                        const isOccupied = data.status === 'occupied';
                        currentCard.className = `current-card ${isOccupied ? 'status-occupied' : 'status-available'}`;
                        statusLabel.textContent = isOccupied ? 'Occupied' : 'Available';

                        if (isOccupied) {
                            currentTitle.textContent = data.current_meeting.purpose;
                            currentMeta.innerHTML = `
                                
 ${data.current_meeting.organizer}
                                
 ${data.current_meeting.start_time} - ${data.current_meeting.end_time}
                            `;
                            actionBtnText.textContent = "Check-in";
                            actionBtn.href = "#"; // Informational check-in button
                            actionBtn.style.opacity = "0.7";
                        } else {
                            currentTitle.textContent = "Available";
                            currentMeta.innerHTML = `
                                
 This room is currently empty.
                                
 Scan QR Code to reserve instantly.
                            `;
                            actionBtnText.textContent = "Book Now";
                            actionBtn.href = data.booking_link;
                            actionBtn.target = "_blank";
                            actionBtn.style.opacity = "1";
                        }

                        // 5. Render Timeline Daily Slots
                        const tBox = document.getElementById('timeline-box');
                        tBox.innerHTML = '';
                        data.timeline_slots.forEach(slot => {
                            const isFree = slot.type === 'free';
                            const row = document.createElement('div');
                            row.className = `timeline-row ${isFree ? 't-free' : 't-booked'}`;
                            
                            const metaHtml = isFree 
                                ? ` Free slot`
                                : ` ${slot.organizer}`;

                            row.innerHTML = `
                                

                                    ${slot.start_time}
                                    to ${slot.end_time}
                                
                                

                                    
${slot.title}
                                    

                                        ${metaHtml}
                                    
                                
                            `;
                            tBox.appendChild(row);
                        });
                    }

                    // Initial fetch and refresh every 30 seconds
                    fetchKioskData();
                    setInterval(fetchKioskData, 30000);
